canon-avatar:pandora.x: Lush, habitable exomoon of the gas giant Polyphemus in the Alpha Centauri A system; home of the Na’vi and source of unobtanium.

67p-churyumov.x: Jupiter-family comet orbited by ESA’s Rosetta spacecraft and touched down upon by the Philae lander in November 2014.

teegarden-star.x: Earth-mass exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of an ultra-cool red dwarf 12.5 light-years from Earth, confirmed in 2024.
